Thanks — confirming product analysis (summary):

1) Root cause: a prefetch/KV cache invalidation regression introduced in release 2026.10.29 caused repeated cold reads for a subset of LLM workloads using short‑prefix routing. This increased average token generation and KV lookups for affected requests.
2) Impact window: 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-10 (matches customer's logs).
3) Estimated verified incremental cost to Pivotal: $43,700 (we cross‑checked request ids with their audit log excerpt and our traces).
4) Mitigation & ETA: patch is ready; scheduled rollout to staging 2026-11-24, prod rollout 2026-12-05 pending smoke tests.
5) Acceptance criteria: production rollout + 14 days of stable metrics (no re‑regression).

Recommendation from product: approve a one‑time make‑whole credit of $43,700 plus a temporary 20% unit price discount for the next two billing cycles to cover customer migration and confidence while the fix stabilizes. Product will provide the final postmortem draft (postmortem-draft.pdf) and instrumentation traces for legal/finance review by Monday EOD.

-Neha Kapoor
Sr. Product Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
